hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the input from the pool manager, converting via phiEth.deposit/withdraw, settling the output, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the concentrated liquidity AMM. Direct liquidity additions to the pool are unconditionally blocked.
